Solutions of acetazolamide sodium in glucose 5% and sodium chloride 0.9% were stable for 5 days at 25° with a loss of potency of less than 7.2%.1 At 5° the loss of potency in both so- lutions was less than 6% after 44 days of storage. Small reduc- tions in pH were recorded, possibly due to the formation of acetic acid during the decomposition of acetazolamide.
